description: Enable or disable public live viewing for an owned published concept map or Futures Wheel. Enable only at the user's explicit request: live viewers see ongoing saved edits, not just the published snapshot. Requires the existing account entitlement and maps:publish permission. Does not publish a private map or invite collaborators. Reuse an identical idempotency key after a dropped response.
name: set_knowmapped_live_view
title: Set KnowMapped live viewing
